Ivy (CSM): Heads-up — MerchantXi token volume collapsed overnight (~83%). Their ML lead mentioned a "Benchly" pilot in an email this AM. Need renewal-risk triage. :mag_right:
redwood-bot: [alert] account_usage_drop: MerchantXi (acct_5509) - 83% WoW. AlertID: UDF-5509-21
Marc (AE): Oof. Who's our champion and any procurement signals?
Ivy (CSM): Champion is Omar, he's been quiet since last week. Procurement said a short eval but no RFP yet.
Rohit (SE): Telemetry (tokens/day):```
2026-08-20: 28,400
2026-08-21: 27,900
2026-08-22: 6,100
2026-08-23: 4,200
2026-08-24: 3,800
2026-08-25: 1,900
```
Tara (CS Ops): Quick play: 1) 20m check-in within 24h, 2) offer a narrowbench (48h) where we control infra to rule out env mismatch, 3) run a regression on their golden prompts and share a short SLO/cost note. I'll take scheduling.
Marc (AE): Commercial: propose a small env-parity credit + an NDA-lite for minimal eval data exchange. Ask for Benchly success criteria on the call.
Rohit (SE): I can prep a repro recipe and a short one-pager showing expected perf delta from enabling prefix caching + pinning q4_8bit. Example toggle we can flip during bench:```
PATCH /v1/accounts/5509/config
{"prefix_cache": true, "quant_variant": "q4_8bit"}
```
Ivy (CSM): Action items: Marc - lead outreach and extract competitor success metrics; Rohit - drop repro + one-pager before call; Tara - book 20m and attach materials; Ivy - prepare renewal risk blurb for AM and flag exec-escalation if they indicate replacement.
Tara (CS Ops): Booked 20m with Omar for 2026-08-26 09:00 PT. Agenda: usage trend, Benchly scope, narrowbench offer, quick demo of caching wins. Invite includes telemetry link and repro doc.
Marc (AE): On the call I'll push for a 48h side-by-side where we host our variant. If they refuse, request same-hardware comparison or at least written success metrics.
Rohit (SE): Quick perf note: enabling prefix cache + pinned quant typically drops p50 on retrieval flows from ~150ms to ~85ms in similar workloads. I'll upload the one-pager to the invite now.
redwood-bot: [note] alert acknowledged by Ivy at 2026-08-25T13:42:07Z
Ivy (CSM): If they confirm a live replacement test, escalate to Director CS for a QBR within 5 business days. Case# CS-5509-NARROWBENCH. Keep thread concise for handoff.
Marc (AE): :thumbsup: will update post-call.
